sentence_text: The amount of information deleted, and the exemption under which the deletion is made, shall be indicated on the released portion of the record, unless including that indication would harm an interest protected by the exemption in this subsection under which the deletion is made.

proposals.quote: The amount of information deleted, and the exemption under which the deletion is made, shall be indicated on the released portion of the record, unless including that indication would harm an interest protected by the exemption in this subsection under which the deletion is made
proposals.action: indicate the amount deleted and the exemption on the released portion, unless the indication would itself harm a protected interest
proposals.subject: deletion markings
proposals.allowed_example: A released record marks each deletion with its amount and the exemption claimed.
proposals.forbidden_example: A released record shows deletions with no indication of the amount or the exemption, and no finding that marking them would cause harm.
